Pune Projects Face Protests and Advocacy Ahead of CM Meeting

Two significant infrastructure projects in Maharashtra, the Pawana Pipeline and the Nashik-Pune High-Speed Rail Corridor, are facing distinct developments. The Pawana Pipeline project is experiencing renewed protests ahead of a meeting led by Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis. Meanwhile, MLAs are advocating for the high-speed rail corridor, planning to meet with the Chief Minister and a Union Minister.
